title: D8616

page_data.en:
British Consulate-General,
Shanghai,
9th July 1938.

Dear Mr. Robertson,

A Mr. G. V. Rowland, a Eurasian of British
nationality, has approached us regarding a "Shanghai
Guide" or shopping directory which he wishes to edit,
and states that a letter of approval from us is
necessary before you will agree to licence the
publication.

Mr. Ogden is not quite sure what is required
in this case, but presumes that you had in mind H. M.
Consul-General's letter to Major Gerrard of 10th May
on the subject of Chinese language newspapers. As
the proposed venture would presumably not be either a
newspaper or in the Chinese language its publication
does not appear to concern us.

Yours sincerely,
〔此处转录不清〕

Assistant Commissioner J. Robertson,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
S H A N G H A I.
page_data.zh:
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海，
1938年7月9日。

亲爱的罗伯逊先生：

一位名为 G. V. Rowland 的英籍欧亚混血人士就其拟编辑的《上海指南》或购物目录一事与我们接洽，并称在贵方同意颁发出版许可之前，必须取得我方出具的批准函。

奥格登先生不太确定此事的具体要求，但推测您所指系5月10日英王陛下总领事就中文报纸事宜致杰勒德少校（Major Gerrard）之信函。鉴于该拟议项目既非报纸，亦非中文出版物，其出版事宜似乎与我方无关。

此致
敬礼，

〔此处转录不清〕

助理总监 J. 罗伯逊 先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上 海。

page_data.en:
July 12 38.

Dear Mr. Creighton,

Reference your note of July 9 on the
subject of a proposed "Shanghai Guide" to be
compiled by Mr. G.V. Rowland, this gentleman
called at Headquarters but did not see me personally.
He will be informed that the Municipal Police are
not interested in his project.

Yours sincerely,

Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)

G.W. Creighton, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

（批：* See also file D 8149 C 2/5）

S.S.
〔此处转录不清〕
3/7
page_data.zh:
1938年7月12日。

亲爱的克莱顿先生：

关于您7月9日就 G.V. Rowland 先生拟编纂《上海指南》一事所来函件，该人士曾到访总局，但未与本人亲自会面。将告知他，警务处对其项目不感兴趣。

此致
敬礼，

副总监
（特别处）

G.W. Creighton 先生，
英王陛下驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

（批注：* 另见档案 D 8149 C 2/5）

S.S.
〔此处转录不清〕
3/7
